stanzas: שָׁלוֹם עֲלֵיכֶם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁרֵת מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן
מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
בּוֹאֲכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן
מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
בָּרְכֽוּנִי לְשָלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן
מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
צֵאתְכֶם לְשָלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן
מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
Peace be upon you, ministering angels, angels of the Most High,
from the King of the kings of kings, the Holy One, blessed be he.
Your coming be in peace, angels of peace, angels of the Most High,
from the King of the kings of kings, the Holy One, blessed be he.
Bless me with peace, angels of peace, angels of the Most High,
from the King of the kings of kings, the Holy One, blessed be he.
Your going be in peace, angels of peace, angels of the Most High,
from the King of the kings of kings, the Holy One, blessed be he.
shalom 'aleikhem mal'akhei hasharet mal'akhei 'elyon
mimmelekh malkhei hammelakhim hakkadosh barukh hu
bo'akhem leshalom mal'akhei hashalom mal'akhei 'elyon
mimmelekh malkhei hammelakhim hakkadosh barukh hu
barkhuni leshalom mal'akhei hashalom mal'akhei 'elyon
mimmelekh malkhei hammelakhim hakkadosh barukh hu
tsetkhem leshalom mal'akhei hashalom mal'akhei 'elyon
mimmelekh malkhei hammelakhim hakkadosh barukh hu

notes: The refrain line is repeated in every stanza of the original and is translated again where it stands.
lines 2.1 and 4.1: 'bo'akhem leshalom' and 'tsetkhem leshalom' are verbal nouns, literally 'your coming (be) in peace' and 'your going out (be) in peace'.
line 1.2: 'mimmelekh' ('from the King') ties the angels to God as their sender; 'King of the kings of kings' is literal (God above the Persian 'king of kings').
